title: SecurityAnalysisEvent
description: Strict schema for structured security log analysis findings produced by deterministic rules and validated LLM analysis.

event_id.description: Unique deterministic identifier, format: sha256:[hex64] or rule-[name]-[hash8]

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of occurrence or detection

summary.description: Concise factual summary of the finding (10-300 chars)

evidence_refs.description: Direct references to preprocessed raw input log lines. Hallucinated lines not present in input are strictly rejected.

line_no.description: 1-based line number in preprocessed input chunk

raw_hash.description: Short 8-character hex SHA-256 of the redacted log line

log_excerpt.description: Exact excerpt from the redacted log line (max 200 chars)

suspected_cause.description: Factual explanation of the root cause or pattern detected

recommended_actions.description: Actionable recommendations for human administrator review (no automated execution)

needs_human_review.description: Must be true for high/critical severities, prompt injections, or LLM-derived suggestions
